differences.name: Boulder Town Hall
differences.reason: Rule 1: the board lists it (1908, 'beautifully preserved'); rule 2 depends on interior access: it holds the Goatcher painted drop curtain, shown to visitors on set days, but the candidate's note says 'seen from the street'. Keep only if research confirms regular public interior access; otherwise reject as an exterior-only civic building.

differences.name: Outback Way
differences.reason: Rule 1 holds (two board pages), but it is a 2,700 km four-wheel-drive road to Queensland: a journey, not a place a visitor spends half an hour at; at most a long linear feature pinned at its Laverton start, and the owner should decide whether a road trip is a spot.
